rationale.org-governance: Enterprise policies, audit telemetry, roles, and phased controls govern AI adoption.
rationale.ai-review: A CI-triggered AI reviewer evaluates diffs and reports defects to maintainers.
rationale.rules-based-checks: AI-generated diffs undergo SAST, SCA, license scans, tests, and blocking gates.
rationale.risk-routing: AI snippets above a size threshold receive extra human scrutiny.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Developers, reviewers, and SREs hold explicit approval authority at lifecycle checkpoints.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent interaction logs capture identity, acceptance decisions, outcomes, and traceable IDs.
rationale.quality-debt: Production evidence tracks defect density, failure rate, coverage, and reliability after adoption.
